AGARES (Gorgon) — Domains: earth, meditation, understanding

Merge: Resistance earth. Your damage may become earth. +5 damage while dealing earth damage.

Pulse — Stand Still: When you attack, choose one: the attack gains multi (2); or, if it is a melee attack, it may reach creatures melee attacks normally can't; or enemies that lose Hit Points from it suffer dazed.

Dismiss — The Earthquake: The party treats Might and Willpower as one die size higher until the end of your next turn; or, deal 30 earth damage to every non-airborne enemy, ignoring the Resistances and Immunities of creatures suffering from dazed.

SEERE (Harpy) — Domains: determination, speed, wind

Merge: Resistance air. While wearing no martial armour, treat Dexterity as one die size higher.

Pulse — The Twinkling: Deal (10 + your current Dexterity die size) air damage to up to two enemies; those hit suffer weak. Gain 1 Turbulence Point (2 if you struck only one enemy).

Dismiss — Sudden Passage: Deal (10 + Turbulence × 10) air or physical damage to one enemy; this ignores Resistances at 2 or more Turbulence. Forces a flying target to land.

PHENEX (Phoenix) — Domains: cleansing, fire, rebirth

Merge: Resistance fire. When reduced to 0 Hit Points, if you are not ablaze, you are instead left standing at exactly 1 Hit Point and become ablaze.

Pulse — The Sweet Notes: Deal (10 + 5 × your highest Bond strength) fire damage to up to two enemies; or, one creature recovers from all status effects, plus 20 Hit Points if you are ablaze.

Dismiss — The Seventh Throne: The party recovers 30 Hit Points and all status effects (40 at level 30+, plus 10 more if you are ablaze); or, deal 20 fire damage to all enemies, ignoring Resistances (plus 10 if you are ablaze).

VEPAR (Undine) — Domains: ice, perception, protection

Merge: Resistance ice. Begin merged with 5 Permafrost Points (maximum 5). Damage to you and your allies is reduced by your current Permafrost before Affinities are applied, then you lose 1 Permafrost.

Pulse — The Bitter Waters: Deal (20 + current Permafrost) ice damage to one enemy, then lose 1 Permafrost.

Dismiss — Ships Laden with Armour: Deal 30 ice damage to all enemies, ignoring Resistances, reduced by 5 per Permafrost spent; or, grant the party a Resistance per Permafrost spent, chosen from dark, ice, light, physical or poison.

ANDROMALIUS (Unicorn) — Domains: divination, lightning, punishment

Merge: Resistance bolt. Gain Voltage when you suffer non-earth damage (2 in Crisis). All your damage becomes bolt, its type cannot change, and it ignores Resistances. While hyperconductive, deal extra damage equal to your Voltage.

Pulse — The Serpent in Hand: Deal 10 bolt damage to one enemy. If you are not hyperconductive, gain 1 Voltage Point.

Dismiss — The Punishment of Thieves: Deal 40 bolt damage to one enemy (ignoring Resistances if you are hyperconductive); strips Scene-duration spells from the target. Re-summoning this Arcanum grants hyperconductive.

BELIAL (Zirnitra, "the Dragon Goddess") — Domains: energy, magic, renewal

Not a starting Arcanum — access is gated behind Revelation.

Dismiss — The King's Favour: Given only in exchange for offerings and sacrifices, this Arcanum heals for an exceptional amount — a once-a-campaign miracle.

BUER (Airmid) — Domains: exorcism, healing, plants

Merge: Gain 3 Medicine Points on summoning; lost on dismissal.

Pulse — The Virtues of Herbs: Spend 1 Medicine Point: one ally recovers 20 Hit Points (30 at level 30+) and recovers from one status effect of your choice.

Dismiss — Cleansing Roots: Deal 20 earth damage to all enemies (30 if you have no Medicine Points left); strips Scene-duration spells from any that lost Hit Points.

SABNOCK (Baihu) — Domains: beasts, metal, wind

Merge: Your damage may become air or physical. The first damage you deal on your turn gains +5 and ignores Resistances if your Defense score is 12 or higher.

Pulse — The Rampart: Free attack with an equipped weapon. If your Defense score is 12 or higher, it deals 5 extra damage and enemies that lose Hit Points from it suffer slow.

Dismiss — Furnished with Armour: Deal 30 air damage to all enemies; or, the party treats Defense as 12 for the scene (13 at level 20+, 14 at level 40+).

ANDRAS (Damocles) — Domains: dread, hesitation, punishment

Merge: Resistance dark and light.

Pulse — The Sown Discord: Name one enemy and one action (Attack, Guard, Objective, or Spell). Until the start of your next turn, they lose 10 Hit Points whenever they take that action (15 at level 30+).

Dismiss — Rain of Swords: Deal 30 light damage to all enemies; those hit suffer shaken.

DECARABIA (Huginn & Muninn) — Domains: knowledge, memory, storms

Merge: Resistance air and bolt. Immune to dazed.

Pulse — The Telling Birds: Reveal one of a creature's Traits, or its Affinity to a damage type you name.

Dismiss — The Falling Star: Deal 20 air and 20 bolt damage across one or two targets, ignoring Resistances, and ignoring the Immunities of any creature you know two or more Traits of.

BIFRONS — Domains: death, isolation, melancholy

Merge: Counterattack extends to ranged attacks. While it is not your turn, your attacks deal +5 damage, or +10 in Crisis.

Pulse — The Seeming Candles: Deal 15 dark damage to each of up to two enemies. If you are in Crisis, enemies that lose Hit Points also suffer shaken.

Dismiss — Sepulchral Shroud: Deal 40 dark damage to one creature, ignoring Resistances and Immunities; they cannot recover Hit Points until your next turn.

ZAGAN (Maneki-Neko) — Domains: coincidences, prosperity, unforeseen events

Merge: After rolling a Check, store one shown number as your magic number; later expend it to replace a die on any Check. One at a time.

Pulse — The Minted Coin: Deal 15 physical damage to one enemy. If you have a magic number, you may expend it: the damage instead equals (the number × 2), and its type changes per a fixed table (air 1/6, bolt 2/7, fire 3/8, ice 4/9, earth 5/10, dark 11+).

Dismiss — All Metals into Coin: Deal 30 physical damage to all enemies; type set by the magic number you lost.

MARCHOSIAS — Domains: fire, loyalty, vigor

Merge: Immune to shaken and weak.

Pulse — Glyphclaws: Deal (10 + twice your acquired Heroic Skills) physical damage to up to two enemies; gain +1 Glyph Point if any lost Hit Points.

Dismiss — Seal of Fire: Deal 30 fire damage to one enemy, ignoring Resistances and Immunities; at 3 or more Glyph Points, +10 damage or a second target.

MARBAS (Rangda) — Domains: medicine, poisons, witchcraft

Merge: Gain a Sorcery Point whenever you or an ally loses Hit Points. All your damage becomes poison, its type locked. Deal extra damage equal to your current Sorcery Points.

Pulse — The Sickness Sent: Deal 15 poison damage to one enemy. If that enemy already suffers poisoned, gain 1 Sorcery Point instead of dealing damage.

Dismiss — The Disease and the Cure: Deal (Sorcery Points × 5) poison damage to one enemy; if it drops them, the party recovers Hit Points and Mind Points equal to their Crisis score.

FOCALOR (Tiamat) — Domains: chaos, saltwater, serpents

Merge: Resistance ice. Ice damage you deal gains +5 and ignores Resistances.

Pulse — The Drowning Grip: Free attack with an equipped weapon; its damage becomes ice, type locked; the target suffers slow on a hit.

Dismiss — The Turning Tide: Fill 2 sections of every conflict Clock on the scene; or erase 2; or rout every soldier-rank non-Villain in Crisis. Unavailable until the next dawn. Affects conflict Clocks only, never Miasma or Damage Control.

BATHIN (Antikythera) — Domains: space, time, void

Merge: Shift your Resistance to whatever damage type last hurt you.

Dismiss: Slows a room, denies actions, or teleports the party to somewhere you've been within a travel day.

FURFUR (Banshee) — Domains: birds, curses, wind

Merge: Halves healing on enemies suffering two or more status effects.

Dismiss: Deal 20 air damage to all enemies, ignoring Resistances; strips Scene-duration spells.

CROCELL (Caladrius) — Domains: exorcism, healing, sunlight

Merge: Grants the whole party immunity to one chosen status effect (status only — does not raise the affinity ceiling).

Dismiss: Heals the party 30-50 Hit Points.

BALAM (Enkidu) — Domains: earth, sandstorms, strength

Merge: Resistance earth and immunity to poisoned.

Dismiss: Deal 30 earth damage and deny an action, ignoring Resistances and Immunities.

BARBATOS (Kuzunoha) — Domains: animals, lightning, sorcery

Merge: Resistance bolt. You can communicate with beast, monster and plant creatures.

Augur Points (renamed from Orb Points) feed a bolt-damage dismiss.

SHAX (Moroz) — Domains: cold, ice, silence

Merge: Resistance ice and immunity to enraged, with a retaliation on melee hits.

The pulse's second-use clause ignores Resistances.

PAIMON (Nimue) — Domains: conquest, heroism, leadership

Merge: +5 damage. All your damage loses its type and cannot gain one (a trade — this counts as exempt from the standard Resistance→Pressure conversion, the same as Variant Breach).

Dismiss: Executes a non-Villain creature at or below your Crisis score.

OROBAS (Ophaniel) — Domains: judgment, protection, sacrifice

Merge: Grants your allies a Resistance you do not gain yourself.

Dismiss: Deal 20 light damage to all enemies, ignoring Resistances and Immunities.

OSE (Qilin) — Domains: knowledge, prosperity, temperance

Merge: Raises Insight one die size.

Dismiss — Oracle: One question, truthfully answered, once per dawn.

BERITH (Tubalcain) — Domains: fire, heat, metal

Merge: Resistance fire. Your damage retypes to fire and ignores Resistances.

Dismiss: Enchants an item permanently.

HAURES (Vanagandr) — Domains: death, despair, hunger

Merge: Resistance dark. All your damage ignores Resistances.

Dismiss: Deal 30 dark damage to a target in Crisis, with lifesteal, ignoring Immunities and Resistances.

FORAS (Oak) — Domains: earth, plants, poison

Merge: Resistance earth and poison. Immune to poisoned. Whenever you recover Hit Points, recover 5 additional.

Pulse — Herb and Stone: Choose one: one creature you can see recovers 15 Hit Points and from poisoned; or, deal 15 poison damage to an enemy you can see.

Dismiss — Things Lost Restored: Any number of creatures you can see recover from poisoned and 30 Hit Points (40 at level 20+, 50 at level 40+).

ANDREALPHUS (Sky) — Domains: fog, rain, storms

Merge: Resistance air and bolt. You may use an action to accurately, truthfully predict the weather for the next day within two travel days.

Pulse — The Great Noise: Choose one: deal 15 air damage to each of up to two enemies; or, deal 15 bolt damage to one enemy, and enemies that lose Hit Points this way also suffer dazed.

Dismiss — Thunderstorm: Deal 20 bolt damage to any number of creatures you can see, ignoring Resistances.

DANTALION (built from Justice) — Domains: counsel, faces, secrets

Merge — The Book of Countenances: Gain a +2 bonus to Study Checks. Whenever a creature's Resistance or Immunity is revealed to you — by a Study Check, by Quick Assessment, or by any other effect — you may record it. Recorded affinities are lost when this Arcanum is dismissed.

Pulse — Declare the Secret Counsel: Choose one recorded Resistance. Until the start of your next turn, the creature it belongs to does not have it — for you and for every ally.

Dismiss — Change Them at His Will: Choose one creature whose affinities you have recorded. Until the start of your next turn, that creature loses every Resistance and Immunity you have recorded of it. Once used, unavailable until the next dawn.

FAFNIR (Hoardflame) — Domains: fire, protection, wealth

Merge — Scales of the Ardent Sovereign: Resistance fire; and, while not in Crisis, Resistance physical. All damage you deal becomes fire, its type cannot change, and it ignores Resistances; while in Crisis, it also ignores Immunities. When you deal damage to only one creature with a spell, +10 damage.

Dismiss — Molten Gold: Deal 20 fire damage to every enemy you can see (30 in Crisis); this damage ignores Immunities and Resistances. You and every ally present then regain 2 Inventory Points for every enemy reduced to 0 Hit Points by it.
